project.name: Vectis :: Plugin :: Enterprise Audit (example)
project.description: Example of a separately-packaged, separately-licensed commercial plugin. In the real open-core split this artifact lives OUT of this Apache-2.0 repository. It is included here only so the spike can demonstrate runtime discovery end to end. It compiles against vectis-extension-spi (the published contract) plus ArC only — it has NO dependency on vectis-core or vectis-server, so commercial code cannot reach engine internals.
